ns2:course.label: Harp
ns2:course.description: Instruction in harp at the advanced undergraduate and graduate level. (Summer session, 1 or 2 undergraduate or graduate hours.) May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Primarily for music majors; junior standing. Passing of an audition is required prior to initial registration in any applied music course as approved by the faculty of the appropriate applied music division.
